title: DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30907v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale. These models are also often tied to the specific embodiment they were trained on, limiting transferability to previously unseen robot morphologies. We introduce a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations directly from point-cloud observations of retargeted human manipulation demonstrations. A contrastive objective is used to encourage consistent representations of motion across embodiments. The resulting unified latent action space serves directly as the search space for model-predictive control, where sampled latent actions condition particle-based future predictions. translated_title: DexLatentWorld：面向零样本机器人操作的三维跨本体潜在动作世界模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型通过使智能体能够预判自身动作的后果，从而促进机器人操作中的规划与控制。然而，这类模型通常依赖带有动作标注的交互数据，而此类数据获取成本高、难以规模化。此外，这些模型往往与训练时所用的特定机器人本体绑定，限制了其向未见过的机器人形态的迁移能力。我们提出了一种三维潜在动作世界模型，该模型直接从重定向后的人类操作演示的点云观测中学习连续动作表示。通过对比学习目标，鼓励形成跨本体一致的运动表示。由此得到的统一潜在动作空间可直接作为模型预测控制的搜索空间，其中采样的潜在动作用于条件化基于粒子的未来预测。随后，可执行的机器人命令可以从预测的几何运动中恢复出来，无需……
tldr: 该论文提出 DexLatentWorld，一种直接从人类操作演示点云中学习跨本体一致潜在动作表示的三维世界模型，使统一潜在动作空间可直接用于模型预测控制，从而在无需动作标注数据的情况下实现对未见机器人形态的零样本操作。
en_tdlr: DexLatentWorld is a 3D latent-action world model that learns embodiment-agnostic latent action representations directly from retargeted human demonstration point clouds, enabling the unified latent space to serve as the search space for model-predictive control and achieving zero-shot robotic manipulation on unseen robot morphologies without action-labelled data.
